title: "Files & formats"

---

This page is the single reference for the structure and contents of a VirMarkDB release archive. For download links, see [Releases](releases.qmd).

## Archive structure

```
VirMarkDB_vX.Y.Z/
├── markers/
├── virus_informations/
├── README.md
├── CITATION.cff
├── LICENSE
└── CHANGELOG.md
```

## Markers

Organised by taxonomic group and marker: `markers/<group_id>/<marker>/`

| File | Description |
|---|---|
| `<marker_group_id>_protein.fasta` | Protein sequences of the retained ORFs |
| `<marker_group_id>_nucleotide.fasta` | Nucleotide sequences of the retained ORFs |
| `<marker_group_id>_virus_orf_description.tsv` | Per-ORF table with HMM hit metrics and virus metadata |

### Protein FASTA header

```
>orf_name marker Kingdom;Phylum;Class;Order;Family;Genus;Species
```

### ORF description table

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `orf_name` | ORF identifier from Prodigal |
| `virus_id` | Genome identifier |
| `marker` | Marker name |
| `copy_rank` | Rank among hits for the same genome and marker group |
| `evalue` | HMMER e-value |
| `score` | HMMER bit score |
| `score_ratio` | ORF score / best score for this genome × marker group |
| `length_ratio` | ORF length / best ORF length for this genome × marker group |

## Virus informations

| File | Description |
|---|---|
| `virus_compo_taxo.tsv` | Wide-format table: one row per genome, one column per marker group |
| `virus_metadata.tsv` | Genome-level metadata: identifiers, virus names, host source, taxonomy |

::: {.callout-note}
For the conceptual definition of a marker group, see [Database](database.qmd#why-marker-groups-exist). For how `mapfile.tsv` drives the pipeline, see [Workflow](workflow.qmd#marker-group-configuration).
:::
